reason: An interactive DeepSeek Harness Blackjack plugin combining a host game service, browser sidebar table, persona-based dealer banter, LLM-assisted dealer decisions, and event-sourced session replay.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带有浏览器侧边栏界面、角色化庄家互动和可回放会话记录的 21 点游戏。
summaries.en: An interactive Blackjack game for DeepSeek Harness with a browser sidebar interface, persona-based dealer interaction, and replayable session event logs.

capabilities: Provides an interactive Blackjack game through a browser sidebar UI
Runs a host-side game service with deterministic session event logging and replay
Uses an auxiliary LLM call for dealer decisions and persona banter
Falls back to preset dealer lines when the LLM route is unavailable
